title: エリザベス女王杯にむけて

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: So you came, Vodka. Are you prepared to battle me for the Queen Elizabeth II Cup?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hey, you're the one who told me to come. Like I'm gonna run from a challenge!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Sounds like you're pretty confident. Since we're both here, how about we make it interesting?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: The winner becomes the queen for a day, and the loser has to do whatever the queen says. How does that sound?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Pfff… Queen for a day? You sure think up some dumb games…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: But fine, I'm in! Just don't take it back when ya lose!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I would never. And besides, I don't intend on losing.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Now, what should I have you do when I'm queen? Hehe! ♪

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hey, don't get ahead of yourself. I've got this race in the bag!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Trainer! While I'm out there, you think of some orders we can give Scarlet!
